summary: This standards-track document defines a new name form in the X.509 Subject Alternative Name and Issuer Alternative Name extensions that ties a certificate subject to an internationalized email address. It updates RFC 5280. It was later replaced by RFC 9598.

eli5.summary: Email names can use letters from many languages. This adds a spot in a digital ID card for such names. It was later replaced by RFC 9598.

questions: how to put an internationalized email address in a certificate
